strings.name: James Dyson
strings.summary: Dyson is known for cyclonic vacuum cleaners and consumer-appliance engineering. Trained in art and design, he built a research-led manufacturing company. Teams applied motors, airflow and materials research to household products; he also supports engineering education and agricultural innovation. His electric-car project ended in 2019 for commercial reasons, and he continued product presentations in 2026.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Advanced cyclonic vacuum-cleaner and consumer-appliance engineering innovation, building a manufacturing business centered on research and industrial design.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 2 May 1947 in Cromer, Norfolk, United Kingdom.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended Byam Shaw School of Art; studied design at the Royal College of Art(1966–1970).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Cyclonic vacuum cleaners
strings.highlights.h1.text: Applied industrial cyclone separation to bagless vacuums and commercialized the DC01.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Engineering education
strings.highlights.h2.text: Founded a foundation and engineering institute supporting student engineering innovation.
strings.timeline.t1.title: 2026 product presentation
strings.timeline.t1.text: Presented the CameraJet electric toothbrush in Paris in September and discussed engineering innovation.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Cancelled electric car
strings.timeline.t2.text: Ended the car project, saying it could not become commercially viable.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Engineering institute
strings.timeline.t3.text: Established an education program combining paid engineering work with degree study.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Agriculture
strings.timeline.t4.text: Established Dyson Farming to explore agricultural-production technology.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Foundation
strings.timeline.t5.text: Founded the James Dyson Foundation for engineering education and young inventors.
strings.timeline.t6.title: DC01 launch
strings.timeline.t6.text: Launched the first mass-produced Dyson vacuum, developing his manufacturing brand.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Ballbarrow
strings.timeline.t7.text: Left salaried employment and developed a ball-wheeled barrow distributing loads differently.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Design studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Entered the Royal College of Art and moved toward functional design and engineering.
